frame_difference_causal — VIDEOSTREAM recursive op

• 資料種類:video → video

• 呼叫:import videostream; videostream.frame_difference_causal(video) -> 'np.ndarray'(或 opsvideostream.get("frame_difference_causal"))

用法

`|frame t − frame t−1|,首影格為零 → (T, H, W)(video`)。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

Same length as the input (unlike :func:videops.frame_difference, `T−1`),

so it composes frame-for-frame with the other stream ops.
